description_en: Deactivates blackhole filtering for a protected IP address
description_zh: 为单个受保护IP解除黑洞状态
kebab_example: aliyun ddosbgp delete-blackhole --ip 47.89.XX.XX --instance-id ddosbgp-cn-n6w1r7nz0000 --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteBlackhole

parameters.description_en:
The IP address for which you want to deactivate blackhole filtering.

>  You can call the [DescribePackIpList](~~118701~~) operation to query all the IP addresses that are protected by the Anti-DDoS Origin instance and the protection status of the IP addresses. For example, you can query whether blackhole filtering is triggered for an IP address.
parameters.description_zh:
要解除黑洞状态的受保护IP。

> 您可以调用[DescribePackIpList](~~118701~~)查询所有受DDoS原生防护实例保护的IP资产及IP的防护状态（IP是否处于黑洞状态）。
